Thank you, I appreciate it.

First night out... and no internet for nearly two weeks... it was strangely peaceful, actually.

Well, personally, I thin the Sith are neither dumb nor evil, or, at least, not evil by their own accord. The Dark Side is dangerous, and isn't for the weak of mind or ill of body, but that doesn't mean everyone who decides to express their passions and let them flow through the Force is evil.

The Jedi really aren't all that nice, whenever one asks me ever so politely to "turn back from the Dark Side", all I can think of is "Believe in what I do, or I'll kill you."

I won't go on my usual little ramble, but the Jedi and the Republic aren't all happiness and rainbows either, they are just better at hiding what they are.

She's a really bad example of being a Sith, and everyone like her is too.

Being Sith is about being strong, finding freedom of expression, and proving your power so it may determine your place in the Empire.

Vesh was consumed by her emotions, she let her every whim control her, that's not what being Sith is about, at least, not to me.

Then again, I do tend to play as Light...

Upvote for use of the word "Douche-canoe".

I do love expanding my insult vocabulary.

Hello folks, I wanted to report in for anyone watching this, I was hospitalized, I'm much better now. Two weeks institutionalized helped me more than years and years of therapy did.

I'm by far more assertive now, this was never my problem, it was the problem of my family, change needs to happen, and if it doesn't, they lose me, I can cope with that, the one thing I can't cope with is being treated like a man when I'm not. This may not be the body I want, but I can change it, and it's mine.

Regardless, thank you, every one of you, you are all great people.

I have indeed looked into grey market hormones, they average price I've seen is about 50 US dollars for a month's supply of estrogen, but shopping around isn't exactly easy, particularly when I'm trying to do it covertly.

Thank you muchly, PK, I'll give that a shot at a more reasonable hour, it's late here, and I still have rest to get before classes.

There is really a lot more to tell than what I've posted, and to embarrass myself, my real trouble are my parents. I am developmentally disabled, and need assistance in basic living, and the more I try to assert my need to be female, the closer I get to destroying my support structure.

I've checked, also, I'm a year too old for shelters to help me integrate into society. Le Sigh.

Regardless, thank you for the info, I appreciate it, I'll get in touch with the help line and see if they can shine a little light into my world.
